sentences.gloss: The big house is over there.
My father is a tall man.
I am not tired. (a man speaking)
I am thirsty; I want water. (a man speaking)
My grandfather is an elderly man.
The new books are on the table.
The house is big and beautiful.
The train is fast and the bus is slow.
My big house is in the village.
We eat in a cheap restaurant.
I go to the new school.
The park is green in spring.

sentences.text: هَلِ الْفِنْجَانُ أَزْرَقُ؟ لَا، هُوَ أَخْضَرُ.
sentences.gloss: Is the cup blue? — No, it is green.
The house is bigger than the flat.
My brother is older than me.
My sister is older than me.
I am taller than my father.
The train is faster than the bus.
The plane is faster than the train.
Is the plane faster than the train?
The bus is slower than the train.
Coffee is more expensive than tea.

sentences.text: هٰذَا الْكِتَابُ أَسْهَلُ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ الْكِتَابِ.
sentences.gloss: This book is easier than that book.
This is the biggest house in the village.
Ahmad is the tallest student in the school.
My eldest brother is a doctor.
My brother is taller than me.
My brother is not taller than me.
My brother eats more than me.
I like tea more than coffee.
We drink tea more than coffee.
The school is nearer than the market.
The airport is farther than the station.

sentences.text: الْبَيْتُ الْقَدِيمُ أَجْمَلُ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ الْجَدِيدِ.
sentences.gloss: The old house is more beautiful than the new house.
I am hungry, so I am eating now.

sentences.text: لَسْتُ جَائِعًا، لِذٰلِكَ لَا آكُلُ الْآنَ.
sentences.gloss: I am not hungry, so I am not eating now.
I am thirsty, so I am drinking water.
I am eating now because I am hungry.
I am eating now because I am hungry. (a woman speaking)
I don’t drink coffee because it is expensive.

sentences.text: يَبْقَى أَخِي فِي الْبَيْتِ لِأَنَّهُ مُتْعَبٌ.
sentences.gloss: My brother is staying at home because he is tired.
alts: أَخِي يَبْقَى فِي الْبَيْتِ لِأَنَّهُ مُتْعَبٌ.

sentences.text: تَبْقَى أُخْتِي فِي الْبَيْتِ لِأَنَّهَا مُتْعَبَةٌ.
sentences.gloss: My sister is staying at home because she is tired.
alts: أُخْتِي تَبْقَى فِي الْبَيْتِ لِأَنَّهَا مُتْعَبَةٌ.

sentences.text: أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْعَمَلِ مَشْيًا لِأَنَّ الْعَمَلَ قَرِيبٌ.
sentences.gloss: I walk to work because work is near.
You are staying at home because you are tired.

sentences.text: هَلْ تَبْقَى فِي الْبَيْتِ لِأَنَّكَ مُتْعَبٌ؟
sentences.gloss: Are you staying at home because you are tired?

sentences.text: لِمَاذَا تَبْقَى فِي الْبَيْتِ؟ لِأَنَّنِي مُتْعَبٌ.
sentences.gloss: Why are you staying at home? — Because I am tired.
The house is small, but it is beautiful.
The houses are small, but they are beautiful.
Coffee is expensive, but tea is cheap.

sentences.text: أَنَا مُتْعَبٌ، لٰكِنْ أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْعَمَلِ.
sentences.gloss: I am tired, but I am going to work.

sentences.text: أُحِبُّ الشَّايَ وَلٰكِنْ لَا أُحِبُّ الْقَهْوَةَ.
sentences.gloss: I like tea, but I don’t like coffee.

sentences.text: أَشْرَبُ الْقَهْوَةَ ثُمَّ أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْعَمَلِ.
sentences.gloss: I drink coffee, then I go to work.
We eat, then we drink tea.
When I get home, I eat.
I drink tea when I am tired.

sentences.text: عِنْدَمَا يَكُونُ الطِّفْلُ جَائِعًا، يَأْكُلُ خُبْزًا.
sentences.gloss: When the child is hungry, he eats bread.
If you are hungry, eat! (to a woman)

sentences.text: إِذَا كَانَ الْمَطْعَمُ غَالِيًا نَأْكُلُ فِي الْبَيْتِ.
sentences.gloss: If the restaurant is expensive, we eat at home.

sentences.text: إِذَا ذَهَبْتَ إِلَى السُّوقِ فَاشْتَرِ خُبْزًا.
sentences.gloss: If you go to the market, buy bread.
We want to travel in the summer.
Do you want to eat now?
I want to buy a new car.
I want to go to school.

sentences.text: لَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَذْهَبَ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ.
sentences.gloss: I don’t want to go to school.

sentences.text: مَعَ أَنَّنِي مُتْعَبٌ، أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْعَمَلِ.
sentences.gloss: Although I am tired, I go to work.

sentences.text: أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ مَشْيًا مَعَ أَنَّهَا بَعِيدَةٌ.
sentences.gloss: I walk to school although it is far.
I like winter although it is cold.
The restaurant is near, so we walk.
The train is fast, so I travel by train.
I am happy because the holidays are near.
